PROOF (replaces the Bitblast.lean:36 sorry; verified [propext, Quot.sound]):

theorem beq_go_iff (x y : BitVec w) (k : Nat) :
    (beq.go x y k = true) <-> forall j, j <= k -> x.getLsbD (w-1-j) = y.getLsbD (w-1-j) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp only [beq.go, beq_iff_eq]; constructor
            . intro h j hj; have : j = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hj; subst this; simpa using h
            . intro h; simpa using h 0 (Nat.le_refl 0)
  | succ k ih => simp only [beq.go, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, ih]; constructor
            . rintro <hhead, htail> j hj; rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le hj with hlt | heq
              . exact htail j (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hlt)
              . subst heq; exact hhead
            . intro h; exact <h (k+1) (Nat.le_refl _), fun j hj => h j (Nat.le_succ_of_le hj)>

theorem eq_iff_beq (x y : BitVec w) : (x = y) <-> (x.beq y = true) := by
  rw [beq, beq_go_iff, eq_of_getLsbD_eq_iff]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos w with hw | hw
  . subst hw; constructor
    . intro _ j _; simp
    . intro _ i hi; exact absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero i)
  . constructor
    . intro h j _; exact h (w-1-j) (by omega)
    . intro h i hi; have hj := h (w-1-i) (by omega); rwa [Nat.sub_sub_self (by omega)] at hj

def eq_eq_beq (x y : BitVec w) : (x = y) = x.beq y := propext (eq_iff_beq x y)
